title: The War Against Slop and an Emerging Weapon to Fight it: Formal Verification
author: Richard MacManus
description: Proving software correct with math has traditionally required specialist work. Now AI and Lean are helping automate the process.
summary: The word of the year in the AI industry over 2026 has been “slop” — meaning low-quality output from a large language model. And with so much code being AI-generated now, avoiding slop has become a daily concern for software engineers.
takeaways: This trend is expected to continue as more models are “trained on long verification tasks.” Theorem and Anthropic describe “LLM-scaled formal verification” as a promising approach to providing security guarantees at a previously impractical scale.
